law_record.title: Obedience to signal of authorized flagger (1)
law_record.text: It is unlawful for a driver of a vehicle to fail or refuse to comply with any signal of an authorized flagger serving in a traffic control capacity in a clearly marked area of highway construction or maintenance or any other area which has been designated as a temporary traffic control zone.

activation_conditions: an authorized flagger is serving in a traffic control capacity
the location is a clearly marked highway construction or maintenance area, or a designated temporary traffic control zone
the flagger's signal is addressed to the subject
residue: whether the flagger is 'authorized' is an administrative fact; the observable is a person directing traffic in a marked work zone
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the signal precedes the conduct judged, and must have been visible to the subject
compliance is judged until the flagger releases the subject
